w71183556.notes: Pleasant brick facade; #2 pot red and #5 lintel red are clean and big. Fix #3: the mailbox is only ~100 px wide at 2400 (14 px on a phone) — below easy size — and its removal leaves a soft darker smudge in the bricks (x~1620-1700, y~760-850); replace it with a different non-colour change on an object >=150 px. Minor on #1: the added bin has a dark fringe/shadow outside the lid on the left (x~2180-2200, y~1190-1250) and at the right edge (x~2355); soften so it doesn't look pasted. #4 lamp enlargement is acceptable (now ~115x245 px).

w72215897.notes: Lovely windmill/thatched-hut scene; edits are clean (cloud gone with clean sky, wheel fully red without leaks, millstone and beam natural). Fix #2 name only: the chimney is scaled up uniformly (wider as well as taller), so rename to 'المدخنة الخشبية صارت أكبر'. Optional: #4 millstone f 1.18 is on the soft side for easy — 1.25 would read better on a phone.

w107455780.notes: Charming garden-bench scene; #2 black cat removed cleanly, #4 pot blue and #5 astilbe purple are whole, crisp and leak-free. Fix #3: the cypress scale also carried the pale foxglove spike standing in front of it — the enlarged spike leaves a streaky stretched column on the tree's left edge (x~600-650, y~300-650); exclude the spike (neg/excl) or use a vertical-only stretch, and since the tree also got wider, rename to 'شجرة السرو خلف الزهور صارت أكبر' unless it becomes height-only. Fix #1: the sitting cat faces the camera almost symmetrically, so its mirror image is hard to spot on a phone (only the tail side changes) — not obvious enough for easy; replace with a stronger non-colour change on another object (not a second cat edit).

w300885.notes: Colourful village doorway with big separate objects. #1 hanging ivy pot flip is clearly asymmetric, #2 mailbox and #3 terracotta trough removals are clean (wall fill slightly soft but matches the photo's softness), #4 trough blue and #5 shutter green cover the whole objects with no leak. Good variety (flip, 2 removals, 2 recolours); door number untouched.

w83335572.notes: Clean, cheerful toy tea-set on white; #2 lidded bowl blue (whole, lid included) and #3 left saucer red are crisp, #4 added saucer sits naturally with its shadow. Fix #1: the jug's spout and handle are almost the same shape, so the mirror flip is nearly invisible side by side on a phone — not obvious for easy; replace with a stronger non-colour change (e.g. remove one of the two small cups on the left, or enlarge the right cup), not another saucer/spoon edit. Minor #5: the added spoon has no contact shadow (the real spoons do) and a small dark speck at its left tip (~x 125, y 1280); add a soft shadow and clean the tip.

w73610227.notes: Rich, attractive still life; #3 big drum blue and #5 lute green are whole and clean. Three edits need work: #1 removing the frame drum behind the music stand redrew the stand's carved collar and fluted column as a smooth brown smear (x~1850-1940, y~880-1100) and left a dark shadow ghost of the drum on the cloth to the right (x~1940-2050, y~880-1060) — redo so the stand stays crisp, or choose another difference. #2 the horn shrink is fine itself, but the stand foot behind it (x~1400-1440, y~1470-1545) turned blocky/pixelated and there is a dark smudge on the floor at x~1300-1400, y~1530-1560; clean the fill. #4 the brass trumpet is a thin tube (~40 px, bell ~100 px) — too slender for easy — and its removal left a visibly blocky stone patch (x~470-560, y~480-640) and a soft blurred panel area; replace with a bigger object change (not another drum).
